decisions.childDefinition: To say a question because you want an answer.
decisions.childExample: I will ask the teacher how plants grow.

decisions.childDefinition: To move toward the person or place being spoken about.
decisions.childExample: Please come to the table for lunch.
The fast rabbit reached the tree first.

decisions.childDefinition: To discover where something is after looking for it.
decisions.childExample: I found my pencil under the chair.

decisions.childDefinition: Holding as much as it can.
decisions.childExample: The bottle is full of water.

decisions.childDefinition: To move from one place toward another place.
decisions.childExample: We go to school in the morning.

decisions.childDefinition: Having been alive for many years.
decisions.childExample: Our old dog likes quiet walks.

decisions.childDefinition: To place something in a particular spot.
decisions.childExample: Put the book on the shelf.
